name: Bread Cloche
alt: Linen ceramic cloche with its lid tilted over a crusty round loaf
desc: For the baker who loves a round country loaf. The dome holds steam around the dough as it rises, then lifts off for browning.

name: Baguette Baker
alt: Three baguettes nestled in a cream ceramic baguette baker
desc: Three molded channels support three slender loaves. The lid holds steam around the baguettes for a crisp crust.

name: Bread Loaf Baker
alt: Cream ceramic loaf baker with the lid lifted over a browned loaf
desc: Deep ceramic sides support a sandwich loaf as it rises. The vented lid gives the top crust room to brown.

name: Limited Edition Pullman / Long Loaf Bread Baker
alt: Dark Pullman baker holding a scored loaf beside its cream-lined lid
desc: A long, covered baker for sandwich slices or a country loaf with room for diagonal scores. Available in limited-edition colors.

name: Bread Pot
alt: Burgundy ceramic bread pot with a domed lid and two handles
desc: For sourdough and no-knead boules. The round pot holds steam under its lid and goes from oven to table.
